task.description: Design test specification and concrete test coverage for OIDC-04 standards compliance boundary. Cover discovery document usage, JWKS key selection, standard-claim validation (iss/sub/aud/exp/nbf/iat), and proof that provider-specific token extension claims are not required for successful core authentication. Produce or extend test artifacts required for TEST-RUNNER execution.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/OIDC-04.md exists and maps to OIDC-04 acceptance criteria
Test plan includes standards-only positive path and negative claim/signature/discovery failure matrix
Tests are wired so TEST-RUNNER can execute and verify OIDC-04 boundary behavior

result.summary: Designed and implemented OIDC-04 standards-boundary test artifacts with standards-only positive verification and deterministic negative matrix coverage for claim, discovery, and JWKS failure paths.
